chunks: And among them is Abu Ali ibn Rashid

key_terms.أَبُو عَلِيٍّ: Abu Ali, a kunya (honorific name) referring to Hasan ibn Rashid
key_terms.ابْنُ رَاشِدٍ: Ibn Rashid, indicating the father's name is Rashid
key_terms.وَمِنْهُمْ: And among them, indicating inclusion in a previously mentioned group

ai.seo_question: Who is Abu Ali ibn Rashid in the context of Shia hadith narrators?
ai.summary: This entry situates Abu Ali ibn Rashid within the hierarchical structure of the Four Deputies (al-Nuwwab al-Arba'a) during the Minor Occultation (al-Ghayba al-Sughra), highlighting his role as a key conduit for religious rulings and financial contributions. His inclusion underscores the institutional continuity of the Imamate through a trusted network of scholars who bridged the gap between the Hidden Imam and the broader Shia community.
